d: Bihar men 'nitish setu' ko lekar rajad neta tejasvi yadav ke bayan par bhajpa neta saiyad shahanvaj husain ne pratikriya di hai. shahanvaj husain ne kaha ki yah pul rajad ke kharche se nahin bana hai, balki yah puri tarah se endie aur dabal injan ki sarkar ki uplabdhi hai. unhonne kaha ki mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ke netritv men dabal injan ki sarkar bihar men behatrin kam kar rahi hai. shahanvaj husain ne yah bhi kaha ki nitish kumar pradhanmantri se mile the aur unke nam par setu banne se unke chahne valon men khushi ki lahar hai. vipaksh par nishana sadhte hue unhonne kaha ki kangres…
